subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should repair intake quarantine all pre-evidence Gitcrawl jobs immediately, or stage mandatory enforcement until migration and representative deployment proof are complete?
rationale: This rollout can stop existing queued repair work and depends on the live job inventory and provider deployment, which repository operators—not static review—must authorize.

options.title: Stage enforcement
options.body: Land evidence acquisition and verification while preserving legacy execution until preflight proves every queued job has a validated replacement or archive path.

options.title: Accept immediate quarantine
options.body: Merge with explicit operator ownership that pre-evidence jobs stop rendering until they are manually replaced or archived.

options.title: Pause for full-stack proof
options.body: Wait until local, cloud or parity, migration, worker consumption, and the planned action-ledger integration are demonstrated together.

recommendation.title: Stage enforcement
recommendation.body: Land evidence acquisition and verification while preserving legacy execution until preflight proves every queued job has a validated replacement or archive path.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the current-main Gitcrawl importer history and is the strongest available owner for the compatible rollout boundary.
